dct_description_sm: Benin administrative level 0-2 edge-matched gazetteer, shapefiles, and geodatabase. COD-EM datasets do not replace the authoritative [COD-AB available here](https://data.humdata.org/dataset/cod-ab-ben); however COD-EM datasets may be preferred for cartographic purposes. See caveats. These layers are suitable for database or GIS linkage to the [Benin - Subnational Population Statistics](https://data.humdata.org/dataset/cod-ps-ben) tables. Vetting by Information Technology Outreach Services (ITOS) with funding from USAID.
dct_publisher_sm: Secondary Administrative Level Boundary(SALB) Project, OCHA ROWCA
